name: Out of Office
source:
The first year of any company is an important milestone, and it’s the success of that first year that’s even more worthy of celebration...

To commemorate this achievement, Robin decides that her team deserves a reward: a short vacation to a cozy cabin in a vast, frosty landscape. What she doesn’t know is that there is a hidden danger lurking in the snow… but that danger won’t stay hidden for long.

Polar bears are not to be underestimated, and this polar bear especially is out for blood. When the team’s carefree celebration turns into a sprint for their lives, it’s up to you to try and get them all back to safe territory.

[From [url=https://celadonstudios.itch.io/out-of-office]itch.io[/url]]
